# Tracker file information

`SURFACE_FILE_INFO=1` requires file jobs and a candidate SDK exporting
`paged-storage-info`. Information switches the file preview to its full byte
length, content version, catalog epoch and caller access. Preview returns to
the bounded text or hexadecimal content. Metadata belongs to the completed
read; a refreshed listing clears it. Providers without metadata report that
it is unavailable. Write controls require an authenticated caller with write
scope and a provider advertising changes.
